name: paint-tube
description: A flexible paint tube with a screw cap, tapered shoulders and folded lower seam.
useCase: Identify paint tubes or concentrated art materials.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies a product or a specific art material.

24.reason: The larger tube keeps the cap, tapered shoulders and folded seam distinct.
